description: Public intake questions for this portfolio prototype. Allowed values still come from the risk rule set and the org policy. This file holds the prompts, when a question is asked, and how a trust-center citation becomes evidence. It does not score anything. A trust-center URL can be stored as a citation. Choosing fetch performs one HTTP GET and stores the page for review. That fetch is not verified evidence. Direction context is optional intake for a person to read beside the residual tier. It is not a score, and questionnaire 1.1.0 does not change the residual formula.
policy_question_help: Asked on every intake, including when AI use is none. Yes matches HR-001 either way. Unknown is not treated as no and opens ESC-009. The score does not change.

context_questions.prompt: What is the most sensitive data this vendor would handle?
context_questions.help: Feeds INH-DATA. Unknown opens a data-classification review (ESC-005) and keeps the tier provisional. It is not treated as public.

context_questions.prompt: What access would the integration have in your systems?
context_questions.help: Feeds INH-PERM. Restricted data with read-write or admin access opens a privileged-access review (ESC-001). Unknown access on confidential or restricted data opens an integration access review (ESC-007).

context_questions.prompt: How does the service use AI?
context_questions.help: Feeds INH-AI. None means model training is not scored. Autonomous use with confidential or restricted data opens an AI impact assessment (ESC-002). Unknown AI use on that data opens an AI use determination (ESC-008).

context_questions.prompt: Will the vendor train or improve models on your data?
context_questions.help: Asked only when AI use is not none. Feeds INH-TRAIN. Yes or unknown, with assistive or autonomous AI on confidential or restricted data, opens a model-training assessment (ESC-004). This answer is not the CC-001 contract-clause check. An omitted answer is stored as no and marked not applicable. An answer that is actually submitted is kept.
Feeds INH-EXPO. Customer-facing adds a small inherent score. It does not by itself open a deeper assessment.
This does not add points. A retention review (ESC-006) opens only when data is confidential or restricted and this answer is undocumented or unknown.

access_evidence.statement: The integration is limited to the access requested.
access_evidence.help: This is the integration's actual access, not a page on the trust center. A contradicting configuration export makes the claim conflicting and opens an evidence conflict review (ESC-003). Nothing provided is missing. That is not a confirmed failure and it is not a safeguard.

trust_center.help: Optional. Use a fictional URL. Leave fetch at no and the prototype does not open the page. A URL alone creates no scored evidence and cannot approve the vendor.
trust_center.note: The URL and the artifact choices are pasted citations unless a fetch is requested. A fetch is vendor-published material for human review. It is not verified evidence and it cannot approve the vendor.
trust_center.fetch_help: No stores the URL and does not open the page. Yes performs one HTTP GET and stores a short excerpt for review. The page is vendor-published material. It is not verified evidence, and it cannot approve the vendor. File import does not fetch.

fetch_options.no: No. Store the URL and do not open the page.
fetch_options.yes: Yes. Fetch the page and store an excerpt for review.

result_notes.not_requested: The URL and the artifact choices are pasted citations. The page was not fetched. A URL alone is not an evidence record and cannot approve the vendor.
result_notes.retrieved: The page was fetched and stored for human review. The evidence validator marks it not yet reviewed because the source is the vendor and no review was recorded. This is not verified evidence and it cannot approve the vendor.
result_notes.failed: The fetch failed. That failure is an evidence gap. It is not a verified control and it is not a successful collection.

evidence_options.independent_verified: Reviewed, and the source is not the vendor
evidence_options.contradicts: Reviewed, and it contradicts the claim

pointers.prompt: SOC 2 Type II report listed on the trust center
pointers.help: One choice is cited for authentication and for event logging. The evidence validator scores each claim on its own. The demo does not download the report. Reviewed and not from the vendor uses the auditor as the source, so it can reach verified.
pointers.artifact_name: SOC 2 Type II report cited from the trust center

topics.statement: The cited SOC 2 Type II report addresses authentication for organizational users.
The cited SOC 2 Type II report addresses security-event logging.

pointers.prompt: Security documentation listed on the trust center
pointers.help: Cited for transmission protection. The document is the vendor's. A review by someone other than the vendor is an internal observation. The vendor's own description stays self-attested.
pointers.artifact_name: Security documentation cited from the trust center

topics.statement: The cited security documentation addresses transmission protection.

pointers.prompt: Privacy notice listed on the trust center
pointers.help: Cited for the privacy claim. Not listed leaves that claim missing. That is not a confirmed failure and it is not treated as verified. A draft ISO/IEC 42001 review prompt can match this topic. That prompt is not a reviewed privacy-law control, and it does not show that a control is in place.
pointers.artifact_name: Privacy notice cited from the trust center

topics.statement: The cited privacy notice describes how customer data is collected, used, and retained.

direction_context.label: Reviewer context · not scored
direction_context.note: These answers sit beside the residual tier for a person to read when deciding. They are not scored. They do not change inherent risk, residual risk, evidence confidence, escalations, the policy outcome, dispositions, or control mappings. A stated direction is not a verified trend and it is not a safeguard. The residual formula is unchanged.
direction_context.note_prompt: What should a reviewer know about that direction?
direction_context.note_help: Optional. Context only. Not scored. One line, 300 characters or fewer. Use synthetic detail. A note does not change the residual tier.

fields.prompt: How is this vendor relationship moving?
fields.help: Context only. Not scored. This is the requester's statement about the engagement. Unknown here means the requester does not know the direction. It is not a missing scoring answer, it does not make the result provisional, and it does not lower residual risk.

fields.prompt: Which way does the requester expect residual exposure to move?
fields.help: Context only. Not scored. This is not the calculated residual tier. Improving, unchanged, worsening, or unknown does not raise or lower that tier. Unknown here is not a missing scoring answer.
